meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开启高强度模式,让助手更专注彻底地完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在特定任务上切换到更专注、更彻底的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn on a high-intensity mode so the assistant finishes tasks more thoroughly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant in a more focused, thorough mode for a task

howto.what: Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:首行固定打印 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`,注册绑定性目标、建立追加式笔记与 todo 清单,把任务定为 LIGHT 或 HEAVY,并用 curl、浏览器、终端等真实界面跑出通过证据后才算完成。
howto.when: 当你请求 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在对话中时接管;它是绑定性指令,加载后整轮按此规则执行。

howto.what_en: Claude enters ultrawork mode, printing `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!` first, then registers a binding goal, opens an append-only notepad and todo list, triages work as LIGHT or HEAVY, and stops only after real-surface evidence passes.
howto.when_en: It activates when you request ultrawork mode and the directive isn't already in the conversation; it is a binding directive.
